title: Review custody for chg-dispatched reviews

story.i_want_to: accept review verdicts on chg-mode stories only from reviewers chg-server minted, and keep chg-server from verifying
story.so_that: a story implemented and landed through chg keeps review/verify separation

rationale: PRD §6, including what the lineage gate does not prove for a chg reviewer.

acceptance_criteria.description: review_complete on a :chg-source story is accepted only from a key whose dispatch is a strict descendant of the source's chg_root_dispatch_id; the root's own key or any other key is 409 chg_reviewer_required. One reviewer dispatch records at most one verdict.
review_records gains a nullable commit_sha. For a :chg story it is required and must be a revision of the story's current binding, else 422 commit_sha_not_bound.
self_review_blocked, caller_lineage_required and unresolvable_dispatch_lineage behave unchanged; the new checks run in addition, never instead.
verify_story, reject, verify_all and the bulk verify/reject paths refuse any caller whose lineage root is a registered chg_root_dispatch_id with 409 chg_root_cannot_verify.

A story that reaches merged with no review_records row for its landed revision escalates over a new control-only edge :review_missing (merged to escalated) through Escalations.escalate_as_control/3, and is never verified.

test_cases.name: chg child accepted
preconditions: a child of the chg root
steps: review_complete with the child key and the landed sha

test_cases.name: non-chg reviewer refused
preconditions: an orchestrator key outside the chg subtree

test_cases.name: stale revision
steps: review_complete naming a sha not in the binding

test_cases.name: auto-approved landing
preconditions: a docs-class change landed, no review

technical_notes: Never convert an exact_role gate to role:. The caller's lineage is resolved server-side from the key (Dispatches.lineage_for_api_key/2), never from params.
